# BNL Community Fixes v2.4

Replay release candidate build.

## Changes
- Added match replay recording filters for custom, casual, and ranked matches.
- Fixed recorder session open/close for the Unity Mono runtime by avoiding Monitor lock calls.
- Replay recorder now records the selected match scopes only and writes the scope into session_start.
- Replay mode launch remains launcher-only to avoid accidental mid-match replay starts.
- Replay browser cleanup: removed old map viewer buttons and added analysis progress feedback.
- Includes recent replay playback fixes and auto-crouch disable registration fix.
